An evaluator that researches livelihoods charities and recommends the most cost-effective ones to donors. Ambitious Impact published one public model of its work; the most recent, from February 2025, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="better-futures-guide-aim">28</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.

**Purely theoretical.** Ambitious Impact's estimate is of the idea, written before Better Futures Guide existed, not of the charity's own results. It is shown because Better Futures Guide runs the programme today ([checked October 2026](https://betterfuturesguide.org/)) and no model of its actual work exists yet.
